name: Real MXN
oneLiner: MXNe is Brale's Mexican peso stablecoin issued in partnership with Etherfuse, backed by Etherfuse Stablebonds (CETES exposure) on Base, Solana, and Stellar.
collateral: Backed by Etherfuse CETES Stablebonds — short-duration (~7-day) Mexican federal government Treasury bills (CETES), held across regulated Mexican custodians with a majority at BBVA Mexico and held through INDEVAL; reserves segregated from Etherfuse corporate funds, issued via Brale's regulated US stack
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption through Brale onboarding, with MXNe intended to remain redeemable 1:1 for the equivalent value of Mexican pesos and usable for payments, remittances, and payroll

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Brale identifies MXNe as backed by Etherfuse CETES Stablebonds, and Etherfuse describes CETES as Mexican federal Treasury-bill exposure. The issuer-managed MXN claim is therefore classified as tbill; this does not establish an NAV fund share or a USD peg.

proofOfReserves.provider: Etherfuse third-party attestations (BHR Mexico) covering the CETES Stablebonds backing MXNe

sources.label: BHR México reasonable-assurance report dated July 24, 2026
